sentences.text: `` Despacito '' -LRB- -LSB- despa ` sito -RSB- ; English : `` Slowly '' -RRB- is a single by Puerto Rican pop artist Luis Fonsi featuring Puerto Rican rapper Daddy Yankee from the former 's upcoming studio album .	Luis Fonsi	Luis Fonsi	Daddy Yankee	Daddy Yankee	pop	pop music	English	English language

On January 13 , 2017 , Universal Music Latin released `` Despacito '' and its music video , which shows both artists performing the song in the La Perla neighborhood of Old San Juan , Puerto Rico and the local bar La Factoría .	Universal Music Latin	Universal Music Latin Entertainment	La Perla	La Perla, San Juan, Puerto Rico	Old San Juan	Old San Juan	Puerto Rico	Puerto Rico
The song was written by Luis Fonsi , Erika Ender and Daddy Yankee , and was produced by Andrés Torres and Mauricio Rengifo .	Luis Fonsi	Luis Fonsi	Daddy Yankee	Daddy Yankee

It is a reggaeton-pop song composed in common time with lyrics about having a sexual relationship , performed in a smooth and romantic way .	pop	pop music	reggaeton	reggaeton	common time	Time signature
Commercially , the song topped the charts of 37 countries and reached the top 10 of 12 others , making it both Fonsi and Daddy Yankee 's most successful single .	Daddy Yankee	Daddy Yankee
It became the first song primarily in Spanish to top the Billboard Hot 100 since `` Macarena '' -LRB- Bayside Boys Mix -RRB- in 1996 .

The official video for `` Despacito '' on YouTube received its one billionth view on April 20 , 2017 after 97 days , becoming the second-fastest video on the site to reach the milestone behind Adele 's `` Hello '' .	Adele	Adele	Hello	Hello (Adele song)
Several remix versions were released following the single 's success .
On March 17 , 2017 , both a solo pop version and a salsa version featuring Puerto Rican musician Victor Manuelle were released .	pop	pop music	salsa	salsa (music)	Victor Manuelle	Victor Manuelle

On April 17 , 2017 , a remix version featuring Canadian singer Justin Bieber was released ; this version helped to improve the song 's chart performance in numerous countries , particularly in the English-speaking world .	English	English language	Justin Bieber	Justin Bieber

On May 5 , 2017 , both an electronic version produced by American trio Major Lazer and Colombian DJ MOSKA and an urban version produced by Sky were released .	electronic	electronic music	Major Lazer	Major Lazer
